{{- /* Links between content files are written as relative .md paths (they also work when browsing the repository). They are resolved to page URLs here; a link to a page that does not exist fails the build. */ -}} {{- $u := urls.Parse .Destination }} {{- $href := .Destination }} {{- $external := false }} {{- if $u.IsAbs }} {{- $external = true }} {{- else if strings.HasSuffix $u.Path ".md" }} {{- with .PageInner.GetPage $u.Path }} {{- $href = .RelPermalink }} {{- with $u.Fragment }}{{ $href = printf "%s#%s" $href . }}{{ end }} {{- else }} {{- errorf "%s: link to missing page %q" .PageInner.File.Path .Destination }} {{- end }} {{- end -}} {{ .Text }} {{- /* chomp trailing newline */ -}}
